Red flags

Hover over each highlighted term to reveal what it means. The Next button unlocks when you have revealed both.

Spoofing Faking a sender name or address so a message looks like it came from someone you trust.

Pretexting Inventing a believable story (for example, an urgent request from an executive) to get you to act.
